//: The polyrepo manifest. This file is the ONLY place that knows the workspace has members. Every repo listed here is independently clonable and independently releasable; nothing below adds a build-time or runtime dependency on the umbrella. `scripts/ws.mjs` reads this and nothing else.

groups.//: Members are checked out into their group directory at the repo root. There is no single `repos/` level: the grouping IS the organisation, so an extra directory above it would say nothing. Both directories are gitignored — the umbrella tracks the manifest, never the members.
groups.platform: Reusable platform artefacts: the contract, the tooling, the templates. These are what other teams consume.
groups.demo: The runnable demonstration: the host shell and the remotes it composes. Fixtures, not products.
